caption:
High Protein Chilli Garlic Paneer & Mushrooms 🍄🌶️
Serves: 2

Calories & Macros (Per Serve)

Calories: ~295 kcal
Protein: 24g | Carbs: 25g | Fat: 10g

1 tsp olive/sesame oil to saute paneer + 1/2 tsp oil to cook base
1 tbsp finely chopped garlic 

200 grams high protein paneer
1 tbsp cornflour, to coat paneer
1 onion, thinly sliced or cubed 
2 green chillis, slit
200 grams button mushroom, quartered

sauce
1 1/2 tbsp green chilli sauce 
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp vegetarian oyster sauce
1 tbsp chilli vinegar 
1 tbsp schezuan sauce

coriander to garnish 
�
Method:
Prep the paneer: Toss paneer with cornflour until lightly coated.
Sauté the paneer: Heat oil in a pan and sauté paneer until lightly golden. Remove and set aside.
Cook the veggies: In the same pan, add oil. Sauté garlic, then add onion and green chillies. Cook until slightly softened.
Add mushrooms: Toss in mushrooms and cook on high heat until browned.
Make the sauce: Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and pour into the pan with half/1 cup water - depends on the gravy you want. Stir well.
Combine: Add paneer back to the pan and toss everything together until coated and glossy.
Finish: Garnish with coriander and serve hot.
